source_title: SightMD Named a 2026 The City's Best Winner in Three Eye Care Categories
source_excerpt:
HAUPPAUGE, N.Y. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SightMD, a leading multi-specialty eye care provider serving communities throughout New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Pennsylvania and Massachusetts, is proud to announce that it has been named a winner in the 2026 The City's Best competition in three categories:
The City's Best is a community-driven competition that invites the public to nominate and vote for their favorite Manhattan businesses and professionals across a variety of categories. The top nominees advance to the official ballot, and the organization receiving the most votes is named the first-place winner in its category.
SightMD's recognition across three eye care categories reflects the confidence patients and community members place in its doctors, clinical teams and staff. It also highlights the organization's ongoing commitment to delivering comprehensive, high-quality eye care using advanced technology and a patient-first approach.
"We are incredibly honored to receive this recognition in three important areas of eye care," said Jonathan Ellant, MD , SightMD surgeon. "These awards reflect the dedication of our doctors, clinical teams and staff, who work every day to provide an exceptional experience and the highest level of care for our patients. We are especially grateful to everyone who voted and continues to place their trust in SightMD."
From routine eye examinations and the management of complex eye conditions to advanced cataract surgery and vision correction procedures such as LASIK, SightMD offers patients access to a broad range of services within one trusted network.
SightMD thanks its patients, employees and surrounding communities for helping make this achievement possible. The organization remains committed to expanding access to exceptional eye care and helping patients enjoy clearer vision at every stage of life.
For more information or to schedule an appointment, please visit www.SightMD.com or call 1-855-295-4144.
SightMD is actively seeking ophthalmology professionals who are interested in joining its outstanding team. If you are an ophthalmology practice owner interested in merging or selling your practice, please contact the Chief Medical Officer, Brad Kligman, at [email protected]
The City's Best is an annual competition recognizing outstanding businesses and professionals throughout Manhattan. Members of the public nominate their favorite local organizations in categories spanning health and wellness, food and dining, education, professional services, shopping, entertainment and more. The leading nominees advance to a public voting round, with one first-place winner selected in each category based on the highest number of votes. The program is promoted by Schneps Media across its network of local print and digital publications. Additional information is available through The City's Best.
SightMD is a rapidly-growing integrated ophthalmic group, offering patients access to over 100 doctors through the convenience of 38 locations across New York. SightMD's track record of providing clinically-excellent care spans over 50 years, and its services include LASIK laser vision correction, laser cataract surgery and lens implantation, oculoplastic surgery, general eye exams, glaucoma management, retinal disorder treatment, corneal services, neuro-ophthalmology, pediatric ophthalmology, and audiology. Sight Growth Partners is the administrative services provider for SightMD as well as SightMD Connecticut, SightMD New Jersey, and SightMD Pennsylvania. For more information about SightMD, please visit sightmd.com
